thread:
Maya: Who's up for a midnight crag sprint this Friday? low tide + clean slabs, perfect speed bouldering. meetup at the lot ~8pm. bring crash pads & headlamps? :headphones:
AJ: Midnight? lol. Count me in if someone brings coffee :coffee: and a spare battery.
Santiago: I can bring one crash pad and my Petzl. calling dibs on the slab line.
Devon: Tempting, but I have a treadmill interval day. Could we do a hybrid — 5k warm-up run to the lot then boulders?
Olivia: Quick poll: react with :one: for run+crag, :two: for pure crag.
Maya: I vote :one: — run+crag sounds fun.
AJ: :one: from me (and I'll bring a big thermos of coffee).
FitBot: Reminder: 'evening-excursions' group meetup — please post your emergency contact & ETA. Safety tip: bring headlamp + spare batteries, tape for fingers, and a charged phone.
Santiago: FYI beta on the slab — it's dry and fast. Overhang dyno still a little chalky from last week, tape recommended.
Devon: I'll switch to run+crag if someone paces the 5k. Maya you in for a 7:00pm tempo?
Maya: Yeah, 7:00pm tempo works. Plan: 7:00pm 5k loop (light pace) -> arrive lot by ~7:30 -> boulders until ~10pm -> post-session hang at the cafe for a snack :croissant:.
Olivia: Can't do Friday night (late call). Could we do a Saturday morning fallback if rain?
AJ: Saturday fallback noted. I can bring spare headlamp batteries and a little first-aid kit.
Santiago: I'll drop a quick route list here before we roll out.
Santiago: ```
gear checklist:
- crash pad x1 (plus shared spot pad)
- headlamp x2
- spare batteries
- athletic tape
- small first-aid
```
Devon: sweet. Strava lovers — I'll post the 5k route after the run for anyone who wants to tag it.
Maya: Adding to calendar now. RSVP in thread please so we have pads/headlamps covered.
AJ: RSVP yes. Coffee and batteries -> on me.
Olivia: RSVP maybe (watching for call schedule).
Santiago: RSVP yes. Stoked. Photos and beta after. :camera_with_flash:
FitBot: Logged the event to 'evening-excursions' and pinged attendees 1 hour before meetup. Have fun and be safe!
